name: Negate Magic
description: Ends or prevents another spell/magical effect outright, rather than resisting or countering its damage.

mechanics.text: On activation, an ongoing spell/magical effect ends, or a spell being cast fails outright — for a spell above a certain level, this usually requires a successful ability check against the spell's own level. Distinct from feat.damage-modification (resists/is immune to a damage TYPE, not the spell itself) and feat.cures-condition (ends a specific ailment already inflicted, not the spell causing it).
